notes: No exact duplicate canonical statements with the same locator were identified.

findings: The article consistently distinguishes exploratory subgroup analyses from the original primary IMpower150 comparisons.
Confidence intervals for key subgroup hazard ratios cross 1.0; atoms preserve the reported estimates without converting them into claims of statistical significance.
The brain-metastasis analyses are explicitly post hoc and are preserved as such.

extraction_limitations: The primary article reports exploratory subgroup analyses with small subgroup sizes and no formal statistical testing.
Brain imaging was performed as clinically indicated rather than by routine scheduled surveillance.
The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated field for multi-arm descriptive rates; multi-arm rates are represented in QuantitativeResult.arms with one declared effect_measure/estimate.
The supplementary DOCX contains a trial-profile figure only; its flow counts were transcribed from the figure.
schema_gaps: No dedicated construct exists for a trial-flow/disposition quantitative assertion; this was represented as population_description.
